name: Flip and prepare cards — one face at a time
notes: Sweep theme 5 (2026-10-06). Scryfall's 'flip' and 'prepare' layouts fell through to 'all faces combined': Student of Elements showed both halves' text at once with the unflipped type line and 1/1, and a prepare card (creature plus a spell it lets you cast) was treated as a spell. A flip card now flips like a transforming card (Tobita is a legendary 3/3 and gives your creatures flying); a Role token pair filed under 'flip' (Wicked // Cursed) is a choice of token, here Cursed making the Ogre 1/1; a prepare card enters as its creature face (Encouraging Aviator 2/3) and its spell is a separate choice.

steps.add: Student of Elements // Tobita, Master of Winds

$excludes: When this creature has flying, flip it.
